title: Danny and the Gentle Breeze
originalStory: There was a dandelion seed named Danny who was scared to leave his home on the soft flower. His friend, the gentle breeze, whispered, 'You'll see wonders up there!' and nudged him lightly. Danny finally let go, floated up into the sky, and felt tickles of sunlight as he danced among the clouds, realizing the sky was full of smiles.
visualBible:
Danny: a small dandelion seed with a tiny, fluffy parachute
Gentle Breeze: an invisible, friendly force shown as swirls and soft lines

pages.text: Danny the dandelion seed nestled comfortably on the soft flower. 'I think I'm too scared to leave,' he whispered, watching the other seeds float away.
pages.illustrationScene: English: A close-up of Danny the dandelion seed on a bright, yellow dandelion. Gentle Breeze is suggested by soft, swirling lines near Danny. The setting is a sunny meadow filled with other dandelions.

pages.text: The Gentle Breeze whispered softly, 'You'll see wonders up there!' With a gentle nudge, Danny felt a thrill of excitement.
pages.illustrationScene: English: The meadow stretches wide, with Gentle Breeze swirling around Danny. Danny is slightly elevated above the flower, suggesting movement. The scene is bright and inviting.

pages.text: Danny let go and floated up into the sky. He giggled as the sunlight tickled his tiny parachute.
pages.illustrationScene: English: Danny the dandelion seed is high in the sky with the sun shining warmly. Gentle Breeze is visible as a light swirl nearby. The sky is a vast blue, with fluffy clouds in the background.

pages.text: As Danny danced among the clouds, he realized the sky was full of smiles and new friends. 'This is wonderful!' he beamed.
pages.illustrationScene: English: Danny is joyfully floating among soft, white clouds. Gentle Breeze swirls nearby, hinting at playful companionship. The scene feels expansive and joyful.
